description: A publication is a scholarly work such as a research paper, journal article, book chapter, conference paper, or technical report with a title, one or more authors, a publication date, and often a DOI or link to the full text; it does not include blog posts, press releases, news articles, or unpublished manuscripts.
examples: Deep Learning Approaches to Natural Language Processing: A Survey
Climate Change and Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa
Quantum Error Correction in Surface Codes: Recent Advances and Open Problems

fields.name: title
fields.description: The full title of the publication, usually displayed as a prominent heading or link on the item's page
fields.example: Deep Learning Approaches to Natural Language Processing: A Survey

fields.name: authors
fields.description: The list of authors, typically shown as comma-separated names below the title, sometimes with affiliations

fields.name: publication_date
fields.description: The date the work was published, often displayed as a year, full date, or month/year near the citation block

fields.name: journal_or_venue
fields.description: The name of the journal, conference proceedings, or publisher where the work appeared, often shown in italics

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Digital Object Identifier, a persistent identifier usually displayed as 'DOI: 10.xxxx/xxxxx' or as a clickable link

fields.name: abstract
fields.description: A paragraph summary of the publication's content, typically labeled 'Abstract' and located below the citation
fields.example: We present a comprehensive survey of deep learning methods applied to natural language processing tasks, covering architectures, training techniques, and benchmark performance over the past decade.

fields.name: pdf_url
fields.description: Direct link to a downloadable PDF of the full paper, usually labeled 'PDF' or displayed as a button/icon

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Subject keywords or tags associated with the publication, often displayed as a comma-separated list or tag chips

fields.name: citation_count
fields.description: Number of times the publication has been cited by other works, often shown alongside an icon or labeled 'Cited by'
